question: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gulzarilal Nanda__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The **Planning Commission** is a department of the Indian government, **formed on March 15, 1950**, to oversee the economic and social growth of the nation, primarily through the **creation of five-year plans**.
 
• The head of the serving government, the **Prime Minister of India**, also happen to be the chairman of the Planning Commission. 
 
• The first Prime Minister of India, **Jawaharlal Nehru was the Chairman of Planning Commission .**
